mapper.select: SELECT MAX(emr_usage_rate) AS emrUsageRate, MAX(standard_diagnosis_rate) AS standardDiagnosisRate, MAX(on_time_rate) AS onTimeRate, MAX(stop_rate) AS stopRate, MAX(chemo_record_rate) AS chemoRecordRate, MAX(chemo_adverse_rate) AS chemoAdverseRate, MAX(chemo_infusion_rate) AS chemoInfusionRate, MAX(critical_value_rate) AS criticalValueRate, MAX(blood_draw_error_rate) AS bloodDrawErrorRate, MAX(surgery_complication_rate) AS surgeryComplicationRate, MAX(adverse_event_rate) AS adverseEventRate FROM TR_QC_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT stat_month AS statMonth, emr_usage_rate AS emrUsageRate, standard_diagnosis_rate AS standardDiagnosisRate, on_time_rate AS onTimeRate, stop_rate AS stopRate, chemo_record_rate AS chemoRecordRate, chemo_adverse_rate AS chemoAdverseRate, chemo_infusion_rate AS chemoInfusionRate, critical_value_rate AS criticalValueRate, blood_draw_error_rate AS bloodDrawErrorRate, surgery_complication_rate AS surgeryComplicationRate, adverse_event_rate AS adverseEventRate FROM TR_QC_DTL WHERE stat_month BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} ORDER BY stat_month
